notes: Flat approximate terrain, not a surveyed reconstruction.
The level roof launch platform is a synthetic simulation aid, not a real helipad.
Building-height attributes are matched by stable GRB OIDN only; the provincial height layer geometry is not used.
GRB geometry requested in native EPSG:3812 and transformed locally; the service CRS84 response has a verified datum offset and is not used.
Arena doors are held open and its interior is schematic. Parking layouts and landmark dimensions are approximate, not a current access map.

water_tower.source: Native GRB KNW footprint, identified against official orthophoto and visitor map; approximate 35 m height, photo-based four-leg frame and saucer tank
